title: Airlock Gauge
story:
The airlock may only open when the pressure is in the safe band.

Input: one whole number `P`, pressure in kPa (0–200).

Output: `OPEN` if `95 ≤ P ≤ 105`, `LOW` if P is below 95, `HIGH` if P is above 105.
hints: Three outcomes means an `if`, an `else if` and an `else`.
Check LOW first (`pressure < 95`), then HIGH (`pressure > 105`). Whatever's left must be OPEN.
The edges matter: 95 and 105 are both OPEN. Use `<` and `>`, not `<=` and `>=`, for LOW and HIGH.
